# Re-scan current green blocks and collect one at a time, re-scanning after each
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
greens = []
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
        center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
        greens.append((center_r, center_c))

print(f"Found {len(greens)} green blocks")

    r, c = greens[0]
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    
    # Re-scan

    new_greens = []
    for n in seg:
        if n['color'] == 'N':
            rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
            center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
            new_greens.append((center_r, center_c))
    
    green_count = len(new_greens)
    collected += 1
    print(f"Click {collected} ({r},{c}): Green={green_count}, Game over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        break
    
    greens = new_greens

print(f"Total collected: {collected}")
</parameter>
</function>
